title: Refine product intent through prototypes
statement: As a product team, we can create and revise interactive prototypes before or alongside requirements so observed interaction and technical learning refine the stories we ultimately commit to.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A prototype is a runnable HTML experience with a stable identity, immutable revisions, and a directly openable entry point.
One Saga may contain multiple prototypes, each shown independently under Product > Prototypes.
The sidebar order remains Product > Prototypes > Requirements even when the actual authoring sequence differs.
A prototype may precede, follow, or evolve alongside stories, and later design discoveries may revise product intent.
A current revision-pinned relation links a whole prototype or a selected element, text, region, or provider object to one or more stories or criteria.
Exploration may begin without stories, but readiness remains incomplete until each retained product obligation is expressed by an accepted story with explicit acceptance criteria.
Unlinked prototypes, uncovered requirements, stale pins, and intentional exclusions remain visibly distinct.
